button.name: Button
button.summary: Action control with contained, bordered, dashed, ghost, semantic, size, and loading states.

icon-button.name: Icon Button
icon-button.summary: Square icon-only control with sizes, semantic tones, and accessible labels.

button-group.name: Button Group
button-group.summary: Single-select control group with shared focus, hover, active, and disabled states.

typography.name: Typography
typography.summary: Type scale with semantic display, heading, title, body, and caption variants.

link.name: Link
link.summary: Accessible anchor styling with color, hover, and underline options.

divider.name: Divider
divider.summary: Horizontal or vertical separator for grouping related content.

layout.name: Layout
layout.summary: Composable Box, Container, Stack, Grid, and AspectRatio layout primitives.

scroll-area.name: Scroll Area
scroll-area.summary: Themed scroll container with controlled overflow and lightweight scrollbars.

collapsible.name: Collapsible
collapsible.summary: Expandable panel and accordion primitives with controlled and keyboard-accessible states.

form-field.name: Form Field
form-field.summary: Form label, description, required, invalid, and error-message wiring for controls.

input.name: Input
input.summary: Text field, Textarea, Password, Search, Number, and OTP.

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.summary: Checkbox control with checked, unchecked, indeterminate, disabled, and labeled states.

radio.name: Radio
radio.summary: Single-choice radio group with labels, descriptions, disabled items, and validation states.

switch.name: Switch
switch.summary: Compact on/off control for toggling a setting or feature.

select.name: Select
select.summary: Native select, custom select, and multi-select with chips.

combobox.name: Combobox
combobox.summary: Searchable single-select field with keyboard navigation and filtering.

slider.name: Slider
slider.summary: Single-value range control with keyboard support and configurable bounds.

rating.name: Rating
rating.summary: Interactive star rating input with sizes, values, and read-only states.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.summary: Interactive month calendar for selecting dates and navigating months.

date-picker.name: Date Picker
date-picker.summary: Date field paired with a popover calendar for selecting one date.

time-picker.name: Time Picker
time-picker.summary: Accessible hour-and-minute selector with keyboard-friendly controls.

file-upload.name: File Upload
file-upload.summary: Button-triggered file upload and drag-and-drop Dropzone with validation states.

navbar.name: Navbar
navbar.summary: Responsive top navigation bar with logo, links, and actions.

sidebar.name: Sidebar
sidebar.summary: Vertical navigation panel for grouped links, active states, and disabled items.

tree.name: Tree
tree.summary: Recursive expandable tree with roving-tabindex keyboard navigation, for file browsers and nested navigation.

bottom-navigation.name: Bottom Navigation
bottom-navigation.summary: Responsive mobile navigation bar with icons, labels, and active state.

breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.summary: Hierarchical page navigation with current-page and collapsed-path states.

infinite-scroll.name: Infinite Scroll
infinite-scroll.summary: Loads the next page when the end of a list or table scrolls into view, in place of a pager.

floating-action-bar.name: Floating Action Bar
floating-action-bar.summary: A speed dial: a circular trigger that fans a column of labelled actions out from itself.

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.summary: Tabbed navigation and segmented controls with panels, active states, and responsive layouts.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.summary: Page navigation with compact, full, disabled, and responsive variants.

stepper.name: Stepper
stepper.summary: Clickable multi-step progress indicator for workflows and forms.

dropdown-menu.name: Dropdown Menu
dropdown-menu.summary: Trigger-based menu for actions, groups, disabled items, and keyboard navigation.

navigation-menu.name: Navigation Menu
navigation-menu.summary: Responsive navigation with grouped links and flyout menu content.

command-menu.name: Command Menu
command-menu.summary: Keyboard-friendly command palette for searching and launching actions.

card.name: Card
card.summary: Composable content surface with title, description, content, and footer slots.

badge.name: Badge
badge.summary: Compact semantic status, count, or category label with soft visual treatment.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.summary: Avatar images, initials, status indicators, and grouped overflow presentations.

list.name: List
list.summary: Composable rows with leading content, metadata, dividers, selection, and states.

description-list.name: Description List
description-list.summary: Key-value content layout with horizontal, vertical, bordered, and responsive modes.

table.name: Table
table.summary: Responsive tables and sortable DataTable layouts with pagination and selection patterns.

chart.name: Chart
chart.summary: Responsive line, bar, and donut charts with tooltips, legends, axes, and animation.

statistic.name: Statistic
statistic.summary: Animated statistic value with labels, prefixes, suffixes, and positive or negative change.

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.summary: Event history layout with status dots, timestamps, descriptions, and left/right/alternating alignment.

empty-state.name: Empty State
empty-state.summary: Clear no-results state with message, optional illustration, and recovery action.

image.name: Image
image.summary: Responsive image with loading and error states plus an accessible fullscreen preview.

carousel.name: Carousel
carousel.summary: Autoplay slides with arrows, dots, and multi-slide layouts.

chat-bubble.name: Chat Bubble
chat-bubble.summary: Incoming/outgoing message bubbles with avatar, sender, timestamp, delivery status, and grouped runs.

alert.name: Alert
alert.summary: Inline feedback banner for information, success, warning, and error messages.

toast.name: Toast
toast.summary: Temporary feedback notification with semantic variants and dismiss behavior.

notification.name: Notification
notification.summary: Notification row with avatar or icon, metadata, unread state, and actions.

progress.name: Progress
progress.summary: Linear and circular progress indicators with determinate and loading states.

spinner.name: Spinner
spinner.summary: Lightweight indeterminate loading indicator for inline and centered states.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.summary: Animated loading placeholder for text, avatars, cards, tables, and images.

result.name: Result
result.summary: Full-section success, error, warning, or empty outcome state with recovery actions.

status-indicator.name: Status Indicator
status-indicator.summary: Small status marker with semantic color and a readable label.

modal.name: Modal
modal.summary: Dialog and alert dialog surfaces for focused confirmation and decision flows.

drawer.name: Drawer
drawer.summary: Responsive side, top, or bottom panel for secondary content and actions.

popover.name: Popover
popover.summary: Tooltip and popover, both floating and portal-aware.

icons.name: Icons
icons.summary: Lucide icon primitive with tones, sizes, and containers.

fuji-provider.name: Fuji Provider
fuji-provider.summary: Sets theme, material, radius and elevation for everything inside it. Mount once at the app root; no component takes these as props.

fuji-portal.name: Fuji Portal
fuji-portal.summary: Renders children into document.body while re-stamping the active appearance on a wrapper, so Fuji's CSS variables still resolve outside the tree.

dismiss-button.name: Dismiss Button
dismiss-button.summary: The bare X control used by dismissible surfaces. No fill, border or shadow - just the glyph, so it never competes with the panel it sits on.

kbd.name: Kbd
kbd.summary: A single keyboard key or shortcut token, for documenting a binding inline.

keyboard.name: Keyboard
keyboard.summary: Full on-screen keyboard in 100%, 75%, 65%, phone and numpad layouts, static or interactive.

code-block.name: Code Block
code-block.summary: A plain code block with an optional copy control. No syntax highlighting by design, so it ships no highlighting dependency.

label.name: Label
label.summary: A standalone field label. Inside a FormField use FormField.Label instead, which wires up the association for you.

textarea.name: Textarea
textarea.summary: Multi-line text input. Registers itself with an ancestor FormField automatically.

password-input.name: Password Input
password-input.summary: Password field with a visibility toggle. Obscured by default, and toggling never clears the value.

search-input.name: Search Input
search-input.summary: Search field with a leading icon and a clear button once there is a value.

number-input.name: Number Input
number-input.summary: Numeric field with increment and decrement steppers. Compact by default; pass fullWidth to stretch it.

otp-input.name: OTP Input
otp-input.summary: One-time-code entry as a row of individually focusable character slots.

native-select.name: Native Select
native-select.summary: A styled native <select>. Use it when the platform's own picker is wanted - on mobile especially - and Select when the listbox should match the rest of the UI.

multi-select.name: Multi Select
multi-select.summary: Multi-selection combobox with removable chips for what is chosen.

segmented-control.name: Segmented Control
segmented-control.summary: Inline single-choice control for view toggles and density switches, with a sliding indicator.

avatar-group.name: Avatar Group
avatar-group.summary: Overlapping stack of avatars with a "+N" tile once the list runs past its limit.

circular-progress.name: Circular Progress
circular-progress.summary: Progress as a ring, determinate or indeterminate, with the percentage optionally in the centre.

alert-dialog.name: Alert Dialog
alert-dialog.summary: Blocking confirmation for a destructive choice - the WAI-ARIA alertdialog pattern. Use Dialog for anything the user may simply dismiss.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.summary: A short label revealed on hover or focus. Wrap the app once in Tooltip.Provider so the open and close delays are shared.
